Real answers

Questions people ask first

Plain answers to what people want to know before they reach out.

Do I need a consultation first?

For color, yes. It lets your stylist plan the time and price before your appointment.

How long does balayage take?

Often a few hours, depending on your hair. Your stylist will tell you at your consult.

How often should I come back?

It depends on the service. Your stylist will suggest a schedule that fits your color.
